title: Making space to write
summary: A first note on making room to reflect on the work, the process and the things learnt along the way.

content.content:
## Why write?

This is a placeholder post for the new writing section. It gives the blog a working example that can be edited or replaced in Pages CMS.

Writing can be a useful way to make sense of a project after the details have settled. It also creates a place to share small lessons that might be useful to someone else.

## What comes next

Future posts could cover a project decision, a tool or technique, or a reflection on learning something new.
